messages:
Avery: Tango found the first sun puddle on the office windowsill. obligs with a shell selfie. https://files.redwood/pets/tango1.jpg :turtle: :sun_with_face:
Sam: absolute legend. shell angle is immaculate :camera_flash:
Priya: rescue story? I need more backstory for my heart.
Avery: rescued from a foster last year, ~6yo, loves romaine and naps. sometimes steals my socks. no judgment.
Carlos: how do you get a turtle to pose? bribe with lettuce? :carrot:
Kira: bribery works. also a tiny hammock. posting a 2nd pic. https://files.redwood/pets/tango2.jpg :heart_eyes:
Sam: GIF: https://giphy.com/turtle-sunbake (reaction :fire:)
Priya: poll: basking or veggies? cast your votes with emoji — :sun_with_face: basking ; :carrot: veggies
Carlos: :sun_with_face:
Avery: update: basking wins. also added Tango to the monthly pet calendar. he insists on being April.
